import inspect
import io
from pysnooper.tracer import Tracer
stream = io.StringIO()
tracer = Tracer(output=stream, color=False)
class Payload:
    def __init__(self):
        self.x = 7
    def value(self):
        return self.x + 8
    async def async_value(self):
        return self.x
init_code = Payload.__init__.__code__
Payload = tracer(Payload)
result = Payload().value()
observed = (init_code in tracer.target_codes, inspect.iscoroutinefunction(Payload.async_value))
print("result:", result, "init_registered_and_coroutine_preserved:", observed)
print("trace_output_nonempty:", bool(stream.getvalue()))
assert result == 15
assert observed == (True, True)

def _wrap_class(self, cls):
        """Wrap all methods of a class with the tracer functionality."""
        for attr_name, attr_value in cls.__dict__.items():
            # Skip special methods, class methods, static methods, and non-callables
            if (attr_name.startswith('__') and attr_name.endswith('__') or
                    not callable(attr_value) or
                    isinstance(attr_value, (classmethod, staticmethod))):
                continue
            
            # Add the code to the target codes set
            if hasattr(attr_value, '__code__'):
                self.target_codes.add(attr_value.__code__)
            
            # Replace the method with a wrapped version
            wrapped_attr_value = self._wrap_function(attr_value)
            setattr(cls, attr_name, wrapped_attr_value)
            
        return cls
